article.title: Transfer Station Update
article.description: The Town of Weston is notifying residents that, due to ongoing staffing constraints, the Transfer Station will continue operating on summer hours until further notice.

summary.zh_summary: 韦斯顿镇通知居民，由于持续的人手不足，转运站将继续按照夏季时间运营，直至另行通知。
summary.en_summary: The Town of Weston is notifying residents that, due to ongoing staffing constraints, the Transfer Station will continue operating on summer hours until further notice.

article.title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
article.description: A new CNBC survey finds broad voter opposition to nearby AI data centers, creating a political challenge for Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm election.

summary.zh_title: 特朗普推动大规模AI建设，选民对此持谨慎态度
summary.zh_summary: 一项新的CNBC调查发现，选民普遍反对附近的AI数据中心，这给特朗普和共和党在中期选举中带来了政治挑战。
summary.en_title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
summary.en_summary: A new CNBC survey finds broad voter opposition to nearby AI data centers, creating a political challenge for Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm election.

article.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
article.description: As Nvidia has gone from chipmaker to industry financier, some investors see the company taking on outsized risk tied to the AI buildout.

summary.zh_title: Nvidia作为AI融资者的角色面临首次重大考验
summary.zh_summary: 随着Nvidia从芯片制造商转变为行业融资者，一些投资者认为该公司承担了与AI建设相关的过大风险。
summary.en_title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
summary.en_summary: As Nvidia has gone from chipmaker to industry financier, some investors see the company taking on outsized risk tied to the AI buildout.

article.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
article.description: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

summary.zh_title: 美国出生率降至创纪录低点，年长女性生育增多
summary.zh_summary: 根据疾病控制和预防中心的报告，美国出生率降至历史最低水平，但30岁以上女性的生育数量有所增加。
summary.en_title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
summary.en_summary: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

article.title: Russia steps up election influence efforts in final stretch of midterms
article.description: Researchers who track online influence operations say Kremlin-backed groups are renewing tactics they've used to sow distrust and discord in previous elections in the U.S. and around the world.

summary.zh_title: 俄罗斯在中期选举最后阶段加大影响力
summary.zh_summary: 研究在线影响力操作的研究人员表示，克里姆林宫支持的团体正在恢复他们在美国和全球选举中播种不信任和分裂的策略。
summary.en_title: Russia steps up election influence efforts in final stretch of midterms
summary.en_summary: Researchers who track online influence operations say Kremlin-backed groups are renewing tactics they've used to sow distrust and discord in previous elections in the U.S. and around the world.

article.title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
article.description: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquefied natural gas exporters.

summary.zh_title: 卡塔尔购买美国天然气的交易显示伊朗战争重塑全球能源市场
summary.zh_summary: 伊朗战争正在改变全球能源市场，并使美国公司，特别是液化天然气出口商受益。
summary.en_title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
summary.en_summary: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquefied natural gas exporters.

article.title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
article.description: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.

summary.zh_title: 这个十年缺少重大影响的中期选举
summary.zh_summary: 过去一百年中的每个十年都至少产生了一次对国会和国家政治产生重大影响的中期选举。
summary.en_title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
summary.en_summary: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.

article.title: This design software reimagines everyday objects as self-aware devices
article.description: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.

summary.zh_title: 这款设计软件重新构想日常物品为自我意识设备
summary.zh_summary: “X-Hinges”帮助设计和3D打印带有互动元素的物品，如灯具和手套，自动嵌入感应器以感知和适应人类接触。
summary.en_title: This design software reimagines everyday objects as self-aware devices
summary.en_summary: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.

article.title: At MIT, Martha Minow speaks on sustaining democracy, both by using and overcoming AI
article.description: In Compton Lecture, the distinguished legal scholar warns of potential “loss of the Enlightenment” while suggesting ways innovations can meet our civic and cultural needs.

summary.zh_title: 在麻省理工学院，玛莎·米诺谈论如何通过使用和克服AI来维持民主
summary.zh_summary: 在康普顿讲座中，这位杰出的法律学者警告可能会“失去启蒙时代”，同时建议创新可以满足我们的公民和文化需求。
summary.en_title: At MIT, Martha Minow speaks on sustaining democracy, both by using and overcoming AI
summary.en_summary: In Compton Lecture, the distinguished legal scholar warns of potential “loss of the Enlightenment” while suggesting ways innovations can meet our civic and cultural needs.
